description: SPRINT_PLAN Amendment 5, Layer 2 (pre-registered 2026-10-31, before any HIST pull or run): the sprint's six surviving runs, rules unchanged, on HIST = 2016-01-04..2024-01-31 (stock history from 2015-11-01 for indicators only; ends before L2). Alpaca has no option prices there, so every option is MODELED (BS, calibrated IV): Black-Scholes on the stock bars at IV = 20-session realized 1-minute vol x the DEV multiplier of the run's contract rule and side (data/sprint/calib_modeled.json). Each block's DEV validation (hist_val_v1) decides whether its numbers are RELIABLE or UNRELIABLE. Costs: 2% half-spread, $0.005 floor, $0.65/contract/side; PF at 2x slippage; the 5% rerun is the stress. 6 runs.
